## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    D_n = \sup_x |F_n(x) - F(x)|
$${#eq-kolmogorov}
$$
    D_{n, m} = \sup_x |F_n(x) - D_m(x)|
$${#eq-kolmogorov-2D}


$$
    F_n(x)  = \frac{1}{n} \text{number}[x_i < x]
$${#eq-kolmogorov-fn}
